description: Archived - Flood Susceptibility Index (FSI) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. This dataset is archived, please refer to: - Collection – Flood Susceptibility Mapping for the new release. This national map of flood susceptibility or flood prone areas is based on patterns of historic flood events as predicted by an ensemble machine learning model. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
